Relive the magic of “ ” — the iconic Bollywood party anthem featuring Sidharth Malhotra & Katrina Kaif from Baar Baar Dekho.
From dance floors to weddings and social media trends, this chartbuster continues to be one of India’s most loved party songs.
Originally composed by Prem Hardeep & Kam Dhillon and recreated by Badshah, the song features energetic vocals by Amar Arshi, Badshah & Neha Kakkar.
: Badshah & Indeep Bakshi
: Sidharth Malhotra & Katrina Kaif
